4b3af702c64ba86f.description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community you will join

The Airbnb ACC Enterprise Ops team is a dynamic business unit dedicated to delivering safe, quality stays and exceptional experiences for travelers worldwide. It helps grow supply and increase supply effectiveness, utilization, & impact using people-powered operations.

The Difference You Will Make

The Manager, Supply Growth Operations leads multiple teams that find, engage and grow our Host community, and sets the direction for how that work gets done. This role blends strategy, people leadership, workflow design and stakeholder partnership. It owns both the operational outcomes and the business relationship. The manager frames ambiguous, cross-functional problems and solves them with data and sound judgment. They help decide where AI, vendors and in-house teams each fit, and build the leaders who carry the work forward.

What You’ll Do:

  • Strategy & Business Ownership
    • Define and refine a multi-quarter strategy and roadmap for supply growth operations, tied to business goals and targets.
    • Prioritise segments, channels and campaigns, and decide where to invest.
    • Own pipeline volume, conversion, host quality, engagement results, cost and risk.
    • Act as the senior escalation point for complex or high-impact decisions across the function.
  • Problem Solving & Decision Making
    • Frame ambiguous, cross-functional problems such as lead convertibility,campaign effectiveness, and the trade-off between volume and quality.
    • Form hypotheses, analyse data, and choose the appropriate operations approach, with clear trade-offs and risks.
    • Run root cause analyses on recurring issues and drive corrective action acrossteams.
  • Workflow Design, AI & Automation
    • Collaborate with Engineering, Program and Product teams on tool choice, process steps, iteration and ops metrics.
    • Identify high-volume, rules-based work suited to AI. Own the logic and human-in-the-loop escalation design.
    • Run supervised pilots with quality checks before scaling.
  • Team Leadership & Development
    • Lead, coach and develop managers, supervisors and senior experts, setting clear goals and holding a high performance bar.
    • Build succession plans and career paths, and keep a healthy span of control.
    • Foster a culture of innovation, attention to detail and host-centric thinking.
  • Planning, Workforce & Vendor Management
    • Make hybrid workforce decisions across AI, vendors and in-house teams. Use in-house teams to build capability and vendors to deliver scale.
    • Plan headcount, capacity and the level mix using volume and performance data.
  • Data, Reporting & Performance Management
    • Own the function's KPI dashboard, including conversion, host quality, engagement, cycle time and cost.
    • Report execution insights and trends to leadership, highlighting risks and opportunities.
    • Contribute to quarterly and annual planning with data-backed forecasts.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration & Representation
    • Negotiate scope and priorities with program management, product, sales, engineering and regional leaders, using business context rather than team output alone.
      • Many of these meetings will be in US time zones, so flexibility is imperative.
    • Collaborate with Learning & Development and Enablement to close skill gaps.
    • Represent the function in broader forums, and build feedback loops from operations into product, policy and process.

Your Expertise:

  • Minimum 12+ years of overall operations experience, with at least 7 years leading managers or large teams.
  • Proven track record of landing operating-model or process change at scale, with measurable results.
  • Strong business acumen, shown by shaping priorities and mandates from a commercial context.
  • Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills, with hands-on fluency with AI and automation.
  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience across global, cross-functional organizations.
  • Demonstrated ability to make sound decisions in ambiguous, high-stakes situations.
  • Strong coaching capability, with experience developing leaders and managing performance.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities.
  • Experience in lead generation, sales operations, marketplace growth or community and engagement programs is highly desirable.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

How We'll Take Care of You:

Our job titles may span more than one career level. The actual base pay is dependent upon many factors, such as: training, transferable skills, work experience, business needs and market demands. The base pay range shown below is annualized, is inclusive of allowances and is subject to change and may be modified in the future. This role may also be eligible for bonus or incentives, one or more equity programs, benefits, and Employee Travel Credits.

About the Role
We’re looking for an AI Researcher focused on multilingual data to help us build and scale next-generation language models across diverse languages and domains. You’ll own research and execution around data sourcing, curation, evaluation, and training strategies for multilingual and low-resource languages, with a strong emphasis on publishing high-quality research and translating it into production systems.
This role is ideal for someone who enjoys working close to the frontier: balancing papers, prototypes, and real-world impact in a fast-moving startup environment.
What You’ll Do

• 
Design and execute research on multilingual datasets, including data collection, filtering, deduplication, and quality measurement

• 
Develop strategies for low-resource and long-tail languages (sampling, augmentation, curriculum design)

Research and improve cross-lingual transfer, alignment, and robustness in large language models

• 
Build and maintain evaluation benchmarks for multilingual performance

• 
Collaborate with engineers and researchers on training pipelines and model architecture decisions

• 
Publish research at top venues (e.g., ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR) and contribute to open-source when appropriate

•

What We’re Looking For

• 
Strong background in NLP / ML research, with a focus on multilingual or cross-lingual modeling

• 
Publication record at respected conferences or journals (ACL, EMNLP, NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, etc.)

• 
Experience working with large-scale text datasets across multiple languages

• 

Solid understanding of:

• 
Tokenization and vocabulary design for multilingual models

• 
Data quality metrics, filtering, and dataset bias

• 
Transfer learning and multilingual representation learning

• 
Comfortable prototyping in Python with modern ML frameworks (PyTorch, JAX, etc.)

• 
Ability to operate independently and ship research in a startup pace environment

Nice to Have

• 
Experience with low-resource languages or non-Latin scripts

• 
Open-source contributions in NLP or data tooling

• 
Experience training or evaluating large language models

• 
Familiarity with multilingual benchmarks (e.g., XTREME, FLORES, TyDi QA)

Why Join Us

• 
Real ownership over research direction and impact

• 
A team that values papers and production

• 
Access to meaningful scale: large datasets, modern infrastructure, and fast iteration

• 
Competitive compensation and meaningful equity at an early stage

Headquarters: Yerevan, Remote, Armenia
 
URL: http://capslock.global

CapsLock is a global IT marketing company that pioneers unique, scalable customer acquisition solutions for B2C clients. We solve complex sales challenges across a wide range of industries, primarily for large North American partners. By integrating our expertise in Digital Marketing, IT, Design, AI-driven analytics, proprietary MarTech, and sales consulting, we deliver powerful, data-informed customer acquisition solutions.

At CapsLock, people, technology, and forward-thinking innovation lie at the heart of everything we do. Our diverse, global team, fluent in over 10 languages, thrives on open collaboration and the exchange of new ideas, pushing boundaries to ensure our clients' success.

﻿Role overview 

Our creative team produces hundreds of video ads, images and ad copy variations every month, and we test them across our campaigns to find out what works best. Behind all of that is a fast-moving pipeline, and we’re looking for a Creative Marketing Project Coordinator to keep it running smoothly.
You’ll be working with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers. You’ll turn ideas and requests into clear tasks, keep everyone aligned on deadlines, review the final work before it goes live, and make sure every asset gets launched and tested. Many of our workflows are already automated, and we’d love someone who enjoys finding smarter ways to work as we grow.
If you love bringing order to a busy environment, have a sharp eye for detail and are curious about the creative side of marketing, this role is a great place to grow. You’ll also be invited to brainstorming sessions and can contribute your own ideas to the creative process.

Responsibilities

Task & Pipeline Management
• Turn monthly creative requests (videos, images and ad copy) into clear, well-structured tasks in ClickUp (our project management system).
• Add briefs, guidelines and references to each task, and assign it to the right team member
• Agree on deadlines with each team and track every task from request to launch
• Keep an accurate record of all creative tests and their status at every stage

Cross-Team Coordination & Follow-Up
• Communicate daily with a team of 15–25 creative strategists, video editors, designers and media buyers
• Follow up proactively so deadlines are met and nothing stalls in the pipeline
• Flag delays and bottlenecks early and help resolve them
• Release approved assets to media buyers and confirm they have been received, launched and reviewed

Quality Control
• Review final images, videos and ad copy before launch against briefs, client guidelines and technical specifications
• Catch typos, formatting errors and visual glitches before assets go live
• Develop an eye for visual inconsistencies, such as AI-generated artifacts, distorted details or elements that don’t make sense in context
• Collaborate with team members on final reviews and approvals

Reporting & Documentation
• Maintain structured logs of what is live, what is in testing and what has been learned
• Prepare clear status updates and reports using automated data and AI tools
• Document all tasks clearly in ClickUp per team standards

Process Improvement & AI
• Identify repetitive work and use AI tools and automations to streamline the workflow
• Help scale the pipeline to handle 100–350 tasks per month without losing accuracy
• Suggest improvements to task structure, templates and handoff processes

Creative Collaboration
• Take part in team brainstorming sessions and contribute ideas
• Turn raw concepts from brainstorms into structured, actionable tasks
• Build an understanding of our creative work and what performs well, with room to grow into the creative side over time 
Must-Have Skills
• Proven ability to manage a high volume of tasks with strict deadlines and accurate tracking
• Ability to turn requests and ideas into clear, structured tasks
• Confidence in following up with many people across teams while keeping things friendly
• Sharp eye for detail when reviewing images, videos and ad copy
• Genuine interest in creative marketing and ad content

Technical Skills
• 2+ years of experience in operations, project coordination or process management
• Hands-on experience with project management tools such as ClickUp, monday.com, Asana or Trello
• Practical experience using AI tools (ChatGPT, Claude or similar) to streamline work
• Experience in a marketing agency, creative production or e-commerce environment is a plus
• Upper-intermediate English (B2) or higher

Soft Skills
• Thrives on structure and turning chaos into reliable systems
• Proactive, reliable and consistent with deadlines
• Clear, professional communicator
• Adaptable to shifting priorities in a fast-paced team
• Curious, with the initiative to improve processes and contribute ideas

What we offer

• Remote Work - We offer a truly and fully remote environment. You choose where you are the most productive and comfortable to have an impact.
• Paid vacations - Generous paid vacation policy to ensure you have time to recharge
• Unlimited Sick Days - We understand that being only human means getting sick or feeling under the weather from time to time, so we guarantee you time off as long as you need to recover and get back on your feet.
• Ongoing Learning - People at CapsLock are deeply inquisitive and eager to learn new knowledge and skills, that's why we support and create learning opportunities like the Free Books program, workshops, conferences, and more.
• Home Office - We will cover the equipment and furniture expenses to make sure you have the best work-from-home experience.
• Physical Well–Being - We will cover costs of your medical insurance. Additionally, we offer an allowance for a flexible fitness program.
• Fun Stuff - There is never a shortage of fun stuff

To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/capslock-creative-marketing-project-coordinator-1

Description

Amazon Prime Video's vision is to be the world's favorite entertainment brand and the first-choice entertainment hub globally. Prime Video is a premium streaming service that offers customers a vast collection of TV shows, movies and live sports, all in one place where it is easy to find what they love to watch. Members can also subscribe to add-on channels (third-party streaming services) and rent new-release movies on the Prime Video Store. Prime Video is at the forefront of the entertainment industry and growing fast, now available in 240 countries and territories worldwide. We work in a dynamic environment where innovating on behalf of our customers is at the heart of everything we do.

As a Senior Product Manager for Prime Video in India, you will own the product strategy and roadmap for one of our largest international markets. You will build a deep understanding of local customers, including how they discover content, choose plans and pay. You will turn those insights into products that grow and retain Prime Video customers. You will define what we build and why, write the documents that earn alignment, and partner with regional business teams and worldwide product and engineering teams to launch and scale features. We are looking for a customer-obsessed product manager with a strong track record of shipping products, using data to make decisions, and leading across teams without direct authority.

Key job responsibilities

Own the multi-year product vision and roadmap for India and other emerging priority countries, and prioritize investments by customer and business impact.

Write PRFAQs, product requirements and business cases that define the customer problem, the solution and the success metrics.

Partner with engineering, UX, science, and the worldwide Payments, Subscriptions, Personalization and App Experience teams to deliver local features on global platforms.

Design and read experiments (weblabs), and use the results to decide what to launch, iterate on or stop.

Build products that fit local needs, such as local payment methods, plans and pricing, partner bundles and local content discovery.

Report progress, risks and results to senior leadership through regular business reviews.

Basic Qualifications

• 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
• Master's degree or equivalent
• Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
• Experience with end to end product delivery
• Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
• Experience as a product manager or owner
• Experience owning technology products
• Experience leading projects across multiple stakeholders

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
• Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. Who we are 

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next People Generalist. 

About the job

This position is needed to support delivery of People priorities. This role supports a number of business functions and HRBPs located in the APJ region. You will be an integral part of the People Generalists team, reporting to the Global People Generalists Manager, and partnering closely with and supporting the work of international and functional HRBPs and COEs across the People team. 

Twilio is looking for a People Generalist who lives the Twilio Magic and has a demonstrated track record of providing advice and assistance with HR queries in a wide variety of areas including benefits & compensation, offboarding, global mobility and employee relations.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Partner with the HRBP team supporting our APJ region functions to support program roll-outs and on-going process execution
  • Analyse HR data and trends across the organisation they support (e.g. headcount, attrition, performance) to generate insights, trends and prepare clear and customised reports, metrics and presentation materials for HRBPs and senior leadership to support decision-making
  • Own and manage performance management cases end-to-end, partnering with managers to ensure fair, consistent, and timely outcomes in line with company policy
  • Coach and guide managers through the performance management process, providing advice, documentation support, and best practice to build manager capability and ensure a positive employee experience
  • Support HR Leaders on ad hoc projects
  • Help to execute and where required lead business led initiatives (re-orgs, job role and level assessments, etc)
  • Partner cross functionally with key stakeholders: Talent Management,  IT, ER, HR operations, Compliance, Recruiting, Compensation, etc. to ensure communications, program, and process alignment
  • Program Management- annual cyclical events such as calibration, pulse surveys etc
  • Maintain confidentiality of core HR data and projects

Qualifications 

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

Required:

  • 3+ years experience in an HR role in a matrixed organisation
  • Ability to take initiative and be a self-starter
  • You are a decisive problem solver with a "get it done" attitude who will thrive in a fast-paced, sometimes ambiguous environment
  • Strong ability to make administrative and procedural decisions and exercise judgment with sensitive and confidential issues
  • Strong data analysis skills and ability to share recommendations with stakeholders
  • Data Storytelling: Connects internal data with external benchmarks to provide actionable executive insights
  • AI-Enabled Efficiency: Enhances productivity through the sensible and strategic usage of AI tools.
  • Demonstrates employee focus and managing proactive communication to ensure optimum HR support
  • Leads the alignment between GTM and marketing HRBPs and COEs to ensure programs are scalable and reflect unique functional needs.
  • Keen to continue learning and developing their skill set, having a growth mindset
  • Strong ability to identify process gaps and improvement opportunities 

Desired:

  • Proficiency with HR systems, such as Workday and ServiceNow 

Location

 This role will be remote, and based in India (only in Karnataka, Tamil Nadu, Telangana, Maharashtra, Delhi).

Travel 

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.
